uncertain: The page names the pictures frontowa / ogrodowa / boczna / boczna. By the plan the 'ogrodowa' picture (one 180/140 window, pergola at the right) is the gable opposite the front, i.e. REAR; the terrace with the large sliding door is on the LEFT long side, which the page calls only 'boczna'.
All four pictures have the same scale (about 79.2 px/m); the ridge row computed from the printed +5,72 is 87 and the apex is read at 87-88.
FRONT: the entrance door wall is 0.90 m behind the kitchen front; wallRightPx 1025 is the right outer wall, which continues forward as the side of the recess.
Window boxes are the dark frames; the thin projecting sills below them (about 4 px) are excluded.
The REAR chimney box was not zoomed; its x range is approximate (+/-10 px).
